svg.title: AI Programming, the public website at programming.chanmeng.org where beginners learn to build software with AI, built and run by its instructor, Chan Meng: five course versions kept side by side from 2024 to 2026, lesson pages for an eight-week programme with a four-week capstone, an AI tutor that answers from the lessons and cites them, and a public showcase of the TechNest 2026 capstone projects. 211 of 220 non-merge commits are Chan’s, the rest AI auto-review and Dependabot; the TechNest 2026 AI Track, taught by Chan as its sole instructor, graduated 30 students who shipped 6 deployed AI products.
